units.group_weighting: each parent group contributes equal total weight; within a group, average piece losses

reference.primary_formula_percentage_points: Cotton [%] + Wool [%] + Lyocell [%] from one 100-point supplier composition row
reference.blank_component_policy: only a row with known complete nominal 100-point total may use an unlisted component as nominal zero for this arithmetic; this is never a chemically verified zero
reference.label_truth_claim: supplier-reported nominal composition only; source's term natural fibre is reproduced as a formula, including lyocell, without asserting a chemical taxonomy
reference.unknown_flag_policy: no supervised metric; never relabel as zero or negative
reference.source_outlier_flag_policy: retain all 11 in primary; flag-stratified reports are secondary because source flag derives from whole-dataset model residuals

primary_endpoint.formula: (1/G) * sum over parent groups g [ (1/n_g) * sum over labeled pieces i in g abs(clip(yhat_i,0,100)-y_i) ]
primary_endpoint.denominator: G=67 parent groups with nominal known composition; each contributes once
primary_endpoint.comparison: outer-group out-of-fold PLS minus outer-group out-of-fold group-weighted training-median constant baseline on the same parent groups
primary_endpoint.reported_difference_formula: MAE_constant - MAE_PLS; positive values favor PLS
primary_endpoint.method_selection_note: a positive internal difference is exploratory, not an unbiased estimate of a later winner selected from these results

secondary_metrics.caveat: published 5.18-point RMSE used a different 57-piece outlier-excluded and tuned population; no direct equivalence

secondary_metrics.formula: same group-equal MAE, with nominal Polyester [%] as y
same group-equal MAE, with nominal Cotton [%] as y
report group-equal MAE separately for 11 flagged and 57 unflagged nominal rows without removing either from primary training/evaluation

actions.ACCEPT: automatic acceptance for a named historical fibre-composition proxy only
actions.REVIEW: no automatic acceptance; human inspection would be required and its accuracy is unmeasured
actions.DECLINE: automatic nonacceptance for that proxy; other routing options not evaluated

optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.eligibility_label: reported fibre percentage at or above the named historical threshold; unknown and boundary-ambiguous rows are reported separately
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.context_only_profile: INFINITED_COTTON88_PREFERENCE is approximate and not a binary acceptance specification
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.selected_set_false_acceptance_risk: FP/(TP+FP) on evaluated nominal-label pieces; undefined if TP+FP=0
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.automatic_acceptance_coverage: (TP+FP)/number of evaluated nominal-label pieces; zero when none accepted
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.review_rate: number REVIEW / number of input pieces, with explicit labeled-only and all-71 denominators
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.false_rejection_rate: declined eligible / (eligible accepted + eligible reviewed + eligible declined); REVIEW is separately reported, not silently counted as a false decline
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.eligible_nonacceptance_rate: (eligible reviewed + eligible declined) / number eligible; distinguishes lost automatic coverage from erroneous decline
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.review_oracle: a perfect reviewer using supplier labels is only a hypothetical upper-bound simulation; no actual reviewer accuracy or industrial route is observed
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.label_error_sensitivity: if a of accepted pieces include e nominal errors and up to k accepted labels are hypothetically wrong, report [max(0,e-k)/a, min(a,e+k)/a], with k stated as assumption; undefined for a=0
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.model: separate cotton and polyester PLS estimators using same fixed spectral transforms, inner components 1..10 and outer groups
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.action_rule: for reported threshold T and fixed margin m, ACCEPT if clipped predicted fibre share >= T+m, DECLINE if < T-m, REVIEW otherwise
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.margin_selection: both margins reported; neither selected from outer results; no operator review budget validated
optional_composition_proxy_actions_if_la.unknown_metadata_policy: three source-flagged unknown-composition rows are unscored and displayed unresolved/REVIEW by evaluation policy only; this uses released metadata, not a spectral unknown detector or deployable feature

required: verified fibre fractions or contaminant assays
information on layers/trims/coatings and processing limits
mass_stream_metric.non_equivalence: item-count precision does not imply mass purity or contamination

uncertainty.method_if_executed: paired resampling of parent-group outer out-of-fold losses, 10000 draws, fixed seed 20260925; descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional exploratory variation for this sample and CV procedure, not a theorem for population generalization, chemical truth or selective risk
uncertainty.no_fold_multiplication: five folds and resampling do not increase the number of independent physical groups
